Test Case Description:
Verify the ability to log in for an account. 
Preconditions:
Valid EPAM credentials available
Steps:
1. Navigate to learn.epam.com
2. Click Log In button
3. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Sign in button
Expected Results: Expected Result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to Home page

Test Case Description:
User can access selected courses
Preconditions: 
User logged in, has assigned courses
Steps:
1. Navigate to "My learning" section
2. Click "Active learning" button
2. Select an available course
3. Click "Start Course" or "Continue learning"
Expected Results: Expected Result: Course content loads and displays properly

Test Case Description:
Course progress is saved correctly
Preconditions:
User has started course content
Steps:
1. Complete part of a course module
2. Log out and log back in
3. Return to the same course
Expected Results:
Expected Result:
Progress is maintained and displayed correctly

Test Case Description:
User can log out successfully
Preconditions:
User logged in
Steps:
1. Click on User Account button
2. Select "log out" in drop down menu
3. Click "Logout" button on the logout redirected page
Expected Results: Expected Result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to Home page - https://learn.epam.com/start
